links.outcome: LLM accuracy on intended-use radiograph interpretation versus surgeon consensus reference
links.effect: Cobb angle within ±5° agreement 90.6-94.5%, MAE 2.4-3.1°; exact agreement substantially lower for Lenke classification, modifiers, neutral and stable vertebra identification.
links.quote: The tested general-purpose LLM versions showed limited reliability for comprehensive AIS radiographic interpretation.

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative diagnostic accuracy study evaluating the performance of multimodal LLMs in interpreting adolescent idiopathic scoliosis radiographs compared to spine surgeons, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
